sources.label: STICK Full Brand Bible Draft v3
Campaign OS Full Brand Bible Workbook, STICK section D+E+K

copy_system.sentence_length: Short to medium. One idea per sentence. Get to the point.
copy_system.humour: Wry, confident. Never clownish or gag-driven. Edge comes from attitude, not punchlines.
copy_system.technical_depth: High where it serves the reader. Low where it distracts.
copy_system.emoji_policy: Rare. Only when tone genuinely needs it. Never as a substitute for personality.
copy_system.punctuation: Sentence case headlines. No full stops where brevity serves. Commas tight. No em dashes.
signature_lines: Everything has to earn its place
copy_system.master_message: STICK is where modern golfers come to get better, and everything has to earn its place.
supporting_messages: Equipment matched to the player, not the other way around.
Modern golf culture without the old guard.
approved_headlines: Everything has to earn its place.
This is why we stock it.

not_us_examples: We are passionate about helping you on your golf journey.

litmus_test: Does this help golfers get better?
Does everything in the line earn its place?
Would this feel like Stick, not a generic golf shop?
